summary: This function calculates the fuel price adjustment charge for a bill by multiplying the units consumed by the monthly per-unit rate stored for the billing month, and it returns zero when no rate exists for that month.

rules.text: The fuel price adjustment amount is the number of units multiplied by the rate per kWh looked up for the billing month, rounded to 2 decimal places.
The rate per kWh is taken from the FPA rate table, matching the row for the billing month passed in.
If no fuel price adjustment rate has been loaded for the billing month, the function does not stop. It returns zero, so the bill is calculated without the fuel price adjustment.
